notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, making it so the next time Village Bell-Ringer dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer.
Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Village Bell-Ringer to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.
